newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 12.4 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 12.4 pct in Jan.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose 12.4 percent in January 1997, compared with the same period the year before, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
January industrial activity also rose 0.3 percent when compared to the previous month.
Industrial sales rose 11.7 percent in January against the same month in 1996, and rose 4.8 percent when compared to December 1996 figures, it added.
